# highlight.js 11.11.1

`highlight.min.js` and `LICENSE` (BSD-3-Clause) are copied unchanged from `es/highlight.min.js` in the npm package `@highlightjs/cdn-assets@11.11.1`: the core with its 36 common languages, as one ES module. A skill install copies files and installs no dependency, so the build lives here. `highlight.min.d.ts` types the part `lib/highlight.ts` uses.

To upgrade, `npm pack @highlightjs/cdn-assets@<version>` in an empty folder, copy those two files over, and update the version here.
